hero_lead: Independent audits, an upcoming fundraiser in New York, and the latest stories from the field.
audit_heading: Where does your money go? The Nepal Audit
audit_paragraph_1: David Grisanti conducted an independent verification visit to our grantee organizations in Nepal, confirming that funds were properly allocated and put to work, a milestone that also marked Baal Dan's 21st anniversary.
audit_paragraph_2: It's part of a broader philosophy: as humanitarian expert David Miliband has noted, effective aid depends on simplified, targeted interventions (like malnutrition treatment) and transparent impact reporting. That's exactly the model Baal Dan follows across all four of our primary countries of operation.
recognition_text: Awarded by Candid in 2024, recognizing our commitment to open, honest reporting on how every donation is used.
recognition_stat_text: 1.1% overhead in 2024, under 2.5% every year since 2006.
